name: Barrio kid (Antenna Hill)
sizeDescription: People in Marea come in every height and build. Whatever yours, your size is Medium.
age: You're an adult, somewhere between your late teens and your sixties. In Marea almost everyone your age has had a neural jack since school.
alignment: The city doesn't make anyone good or evil; it just puts a price on both.
languageDescription: You speak, read and write the common tongue of Marea, Spanish with a port's worth of borrowed words, and the street slang of your barrio.

traits.name: Hill Runner
traits.description: You grew up on Antenna Hill's stairways and rooftops. You have proficiency in the Stealth and Insight skills.

traits.name: Free Mesh
traits.description: You always find a free-mesh access point: anywhere in Marea outside La Cúspide you can get online without a paid line or an account anyone can trace back to you.

name: Corp brat (La Cúspide)
sizeDescription: People in Marea come in every height and build. Whatever yours, your size is Medium.

traits.name: Boardroom Manners
traits.description: You learnt to ask for things the way rich people do. You have proficiency in the Persuasion skill.

traits.name: Old Corp ID
traits.description: An expired corporate ID nobody bothered to revoke. Once a day it opens a low-security corporate door, turnstile or lift in La Cúspide, or gets you past a lobby guard without a check. Every use risks a flag; the DM decides when it stops working.

traits.name: Canal-born
traits.description: You learnt to swim before you could read. You have proficiency in the Athletics and Perception skills, a swimming speed equal to your walking speed, and you can hold your breath for 10 minutes.

traits.name: Know the Canals
traits.description: In Los Anegados you never get lost, you know a waterway shortcut between any two points, and you have advantage on checks to lose a pursuer there.

sizeDescription: People in Marea come in every height and build. Whatever yours, your size is Medium.

languageDescription: You speak, read and write the common tongue of Marea, Spanish with a port's worth of borrowed words, and the street slang of your barrio.

traits.name: Dock Hand
traits.description: You grew up loading what the automated cranes dropped. You have proficiency in the Deception skill and with land and water vehicles.

traits.name: Port Contacts
traits.description: Your family still works El Puerto. You can always find someone there who'll move a crate, a person or a rumour off the books, for a price, and you hear what came in on the night ships.

name: Vantis trial kid
sizeDescription: People in Marea come in every height and build. Whatever yours, your size is Medium.
age: You're an adult, somewhere between your late teens and your sixties. In Marea almost everyone your age has had a neural jack since school.

traits.name: Experimental Jack
traits.description: The prototype jack Vantis put in you as a child is still faster than anything on the market. You have +1 RAM: one extra level 1 program slot.

traits.name: Hardened Mind
traits.description: Your neural tissue grew around the prototype. You have resistance to psychic damage.

traits.name: Vantis Wants You Back
traits.description: You belong to a trial cohort Vantis never closed. Their systems recognise your jack's signature on any network they own, and every so often someone from Vantis comes looking for you.

traits.name: Ferro Training
traits.description: You did a contract with Grupo Ferro before you walked, or were walked out. You have proficiency with firearms (pistols, submachine guns, shotguns and rifles) and with light armour.

traits.name: Know the Routine
traits.description: You have advantage on checks to spot patrols, guard rotations, camera sweeps and other security routines, and to guess where Ferro will look next.

traits.name: Half a Degree
traits.description: You left Ciudad Universitaria with debts and half a degree. You have proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Still on the List
traits.description: Nobody closed your student account: you can get into the university's libraries, labs and campus network, and you know which professors still answer your messages.

sizeDescription: People in Marea come in every height and build. Whatever yours, your size is Medium.

languageDescription: You speak, read and write the common tongue of Marea, Spanish with a port's worth of borrowed words, and the street slang of your barrio.

traits.name: Road-born
traits.description: Your family drove the coast road between the dry towns. You have proficiency in the Survival skill and with land vehicles: you can drive anything with wheels and fix it at the roadside.

traits.name: Long Haul
traits.description: You've slept in truck cabs and dry riverbeds. You need only half the usual water, and you have advantage on Constitution saving throws against exhaustion from travel, heat and thirst.
